Meteg after silluq: manuscript images for the verse-final word at 1 Kgs. 14:14

← Back to the case register.

At 1 Kgs. 14:14, Aleppo lacks the second metsil that Leningrad has. Leningrad's second metsil is the likely meteg after the silluq.

Cairo has the silluq alone.

Sassoon has the silluq alone.
